# SaltWatch 2.2.2

SaltWatch 2.2.2 adds user-approved managed firmware updates while preserving
the existing Device Builder and local upload paths.

## Changes

- Added a Firmware Update entity to Home Assistant and the local SaltWatch
  interface.
- Checks the official GitHub Pages release manifest every six hours over
  verified HTTPS.
- Requires explicit approval before every installation; updates are never
  installed automatically.
- Added a Device Maintenance group to the local interface.
- Added a versioned OTA binary and its MD5 metadata to the installer manifest.
- Retained native ESPHome OTA and web-server OTA for customization and recovery.

## First managed update

Install 2.2.2 once through ESPHome Device Builder or by manually uploading its
OTA binary. Future releases will then appear through the Firmware Update entity.

The managed updater installs the canonical SaltWatch build. Install through
Device Builder instead if you maintain custom YAML overrides.
